title: A new text model for Roblox roleplay
summary:
A new roleplay text model joined the lineup, text-request tracking got more useful, and the community catalog gained a Telegram bot.

Added `roblox-rp` with anonymous access and tool support. Requests route to either Llama 3 8B Instruct or Mistral Small 2402. The same work kept Bedrock conversations valid when messages have empty content or begin without a user message.

Moved `openai-large` access from seed to flower and removed `gpt-5-nano` from the model list. Text-request tracking now records timing, status, model selection, token usage, and moderation results.

Pollix AI, a community-built multilingual assistant with image understanding, was added to the project list and social bots catalog.
